summary: Frontend-only testing of GitHelp SPA completed. All requested features work: routing (Home/Commands/Chatbot/404), Home hero + CTA cards, Command Explorer live search (24 -> 3 for 'undo') and category filtering ('Setup' -> 2, 'All' -> 24), copy buttons on 24 command cards, Chatbot rule-based matching ('undo my last commit' returned an answer containing 'git reset --soft'), fallback answer for nonsense ('banana pancakes' -> 'I'm not sure...'), and mobile hamburger toggle opens/closes the nav-links.

issues: Opened nav-links panel renders with a dark background while the app is a light theme; contrast is fine but visual inconsistency vs light theme spec — cosmetic only

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chatbot initializes with one welcome bot bubble; suggestion chips are shown initially but disappear once the user has sent messages (this is expected per code in ChatWindow which only renders suggestions when suggestions.length > 0). Result-count element uses format '<n> command(s) [in <Category>]'. Category chip testids follow lowercased-and-hyphenated pattern e.g. category-branching-&-merging (& is replaced by '-' by code, so testid is category-branching---merging).
